name: @letbuyy/lcis-performance
description: LPAS — Performance Analytics System. Read-only performance intelligence: a per-entity metric catalog bound to exact live sources (values honestly NOT_CONNECTED until series are provided), pure statistics, structural latency models (models, never measurements), capacity/growth/cost forecasts delegated to the lcis-operations forecast methods, and ADVISORY-ONLY recommendations. Never mutates infrastructure; never fabricates a measurement.
